[LSER.7.6.2] `by: none` opts into a single state allocation
per (schema, slot) with no per-identity breakdown. Useful for
global aggregations across all entities of a schema: rolling
1_h count of all `DoorOpened` events, or of all `CallError` facts
regardless of target service. Authors
who want both per-entity and global statistics declare two
series on two slots.
